corrected_content.problem:
A curve is defined by the parametric equations
$$
\displaystyle x = t - 1, y = t^{3} - 2, - ∞ < t < ∞.
$$

Determine the values of $t$ at which the tangent to the curve is horizontal.
corrected_content.worked_solution: Since $dx/dt=1$ and $dy/dt=3t^2$, we have $dy/dx=3t^2$. A horizontal tangent requires $dy/dx=0$, which gives $t=0$.
